tested_conditions.behavior: Continuous observing coroutine pauses or steps down sampling frequency to conserve battery; stateflow retains latest observation but increments age.
In-memory bus drops transient messages; Room database reloads historical cases and memory patterns. Sentinel performs immediate observeNow() to prevent false-healthy or stale assumptions.
tested_conditions.findings: Zero replay storm observed because ephemeral bus is re-initialized empty; persisted cases retain their last known status.

tested_conditions.behavior: Interrupted reasoning coroutine is cancelled cleanly; upon restart, incident must be re-evaluated against fresh telemetry rather than replaying old prompt.
Standard Android applications cannot guarantee uninterrupted 24x7 background execution without a Foreground Service notification and battery exemption.
tested_conditions.documentation: V-Watcher does NOT claim unkillable 24x7 background daemon execution; lifecycle boundaries are strictly respected.
